web_events.query: Federal Reserve speech this week monetary policy
web_events.answer: The Federal Reserve left its key interest rate unchanged at its most recent meeting, marking the fifth consecutive meeting with no change to the benchmark rate, which remains around 3.6%. Despite this decision, three officials, including Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, dissented in favor of a rate hike to better balance the outlook and risks for the Fed’s dual mandate goals. web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's official manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) fell to 49.2 in July from 50.3 in June, indicating a contraction as it dropped below the 50-point threshold. This decline was unexpected, as economists had forecasted a PMI of 50. The sub-index for new orders and production also fell, reflecting weak domestic demand and possible disruptions from typhoons.
